description.content:
Matches to a corresponding record on PropTrack's master address file based on a given address string.

Refer to the [API Guide](https://developer.proptrack.com.au/docs/apis/guide#address-matching) for best practices for input address formatting.

header.description: (Required) Provide your bearer token as a string, in the format `Bearer {access_token}` in the Authorization Header</br>Refer to [Authentication](https://developer.proptrack.com.au/docs/apis/authentication/operations/create-a-oauth-2-token)
Should be quoted as a reference for any support request/unexpected error
